title: 1 Enoch 73 — The moon's nature and her monthly waxing

translation.sourceText: 1 Enoch Astronomical Book (Book of the Luminaries / Sefer ha-Mazzalot) — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Aramaic DSS 4Q208-4Q211, OLDEST surviving Enoch material late 3rd c. paragraphs.text: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ሕግ፡ ርእኩ፡ ሕገ፡ ካልዕተ፡ ለብርሃን፡ ዘንዑስ፡ ዘስሙ፡ ወርኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə ḥəg rəʾku ḥəga kāləʿta la-bərhān zanəʿus zasəmu warḫ

i18n.en: And after this law I saw another law for the lesser luminary, whose name is the moon.

paragraphs.text: ወሰፍሐ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሑረቶ፡ በበ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ ወብርሃኖ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ለመዋዕሊሁ፡ ኵሉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-safḥa lotu kwəlo ḥurato baba ḥəgagihu wa-bərhāno ḫolaqo la-mawāʿəlihu kwəlu

i18n.en: And he set forth for it its whole course according to its laws, and the reckoning of its light for all its days.

paragraphs.text: ወብርሃኑ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡ ወበዐቢይ፡ ኆለቅ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ይትዌቅሕ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bərhānu sabʿa məsla bərhānā la-ḍaḥay yəkawwən bərhānā la-warḫ wa-ba-ʿabəy ḫolaq yəkawwən bərhānā la-ḍaḥay yətwaḳḳəḥ məlʿta bərhānā la-warḫ

i18n.en: And her light is the moon's light, which is sevenfold less than the light of the sun; and in the great reckoning the light of the sun is measured against the full light of the moon.

paragraphs.text: וקדמי קומה במדנחא יפק ביום ארבעת עשר וכד יסלק לסיהרא יהוה לתרין שבעין יומין מלי נהורהא
paragraphs.translit: u-qadmē qōmaha bě-madnāḥāʾ yippōq bě-yōm ʾarbaʿat ʿaśar wě-kad yissalleq lě-sahrāʾ yěhěwēh li-trēn šābūʿīn yōmīn malē něhōrahā

i18n.en: And in her first phase she rises in the east on the fourteenth day; and when she ascends to her fullness, in two weeks of days her light is full.

notes.official:
**Aramaic-PRIMARY witness — 4Q209 frag 7 col. ii.** This verse is preserved in the Aramaic 4Q209 fragment in fuller form than the Ge'ez transmission. The 14-day-waxing + full-moon-at-two-weeks is the foundational lunar-month structure of the Astronomical Book; the Aramaic 4Q208 + 4Q209 fragments preserve a much fuller day-by-day fractional tabulation (the seven-part visible-light grid divided into half-parts, giving a 49-unit-fractional grid for the synodic cycle) that the Ge'ez transmission has heavily abbreviated.

The witness-fullness-inversion at chs 73-74 (the Aramaic preserves more than the Ge'ez) is unusual within the 1 Enoch corpus and is one of the most-distinctive textual-features of the Astronomical Book. The original Aramaic Astronomical Book was substantially longer than what the Ge'ez preserves — perhaps two or three times the surviving Ge'ez length. See overlay entry `aramaic-fuller-than-geez-lunar-tables-4q208-convention` and the foundational scholarly treatment in H. Drawnel *The Aramaic Astronomical Book (4Q208-4Q211) from Qumran* (Oxford 2011).

paragraphs.text: ወትበጽሕ፡ ብርሃና፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ለስብዕት፡ ክፍል፡ አሐደ፡ እምነ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-təbaṣṣəḥ bərhānā lāʿlēhā la-səbʿət kəfl ʾaḥada ʾəmənna bərhānu la-ḍaḥay

i18n.en: And her light reaches her by one seventh part out of the light of the sun.

paragraphs.text: ወበቀዳሚ፡ ዕለታ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕ፡ ክፍላት፡ ወትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ በቀዳሚ፡ ዕለታ፡ ብርሃና፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕ፡ ክፍላት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-qadāmi ʿəlatā yəkawwən bərhānā sabʿa məsla ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿ kəflāt wa-təgabbəʾ bərhānā ba-qadāmi ʿəlatā bərhānā sabʿa məsla ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿ kəflāt

i18n.en: And on her first day her light is one seventh together with one fourteenth part; and her light returns on her first day — her light is one seventh together with one fourteenth.

notes.official: **The 1/7 + 1/14 = 3/14 fractional formula for day 1 of the lunar month.** The verse states the lunar-disk-visible-fraction for day 1 of the synodic cycle: one seventh + one fourteenth = 3/14 of the disk visible. The Ge'ez transmission of this verse is acknowledged corrupted (Charles 1912 noted the corruption; conjectures various emendations of the 1/14 × 1/7 fractional formula); the Aramaic 4Q208 stratum preserves a dramatically fuller computational-tabulation for the day-by-day fractional progression across the synodic cycle. The WoH translation preserves the Ge'ez witness verbatim per the per-verse layered-witness convention; the corrupted-state is flagged.

paragraphs.text: ወትትባእ፡ ብርሃና፡ በስብዕ፡ ክፍላት፡ ፍጽም፡ ወትበጽሕ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለኬራ፡ ዘምሥራቅ፡ ወትሥረቅ፡ ወትበርህ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-tətbāʾ bərhānā ba-səbʿ kəflāt fəṣṣəm wa-təbaṣṣəḥ bərhānā la-kērā za-məśrāq wa-təśraq wa-təbarrəh

i18n.en: And her light enters in by seven parts in full, and her light reaches her horn in the east, and she rises and shines.

paragraphs.text: ወካዕበ፡ ትትዌቅሕ፡ በበ፡ ዕለታ፡ ብርሃና፡ ወይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ድልዋ፡ ለፀሐይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kāʿba tətwaḳḳəḥ baba ʿəlatā bərhānā wa-yəkawwən bərhānā dəlwā la-ḍaḥay

i18n.en: And again her light is measured out day by day, and her light becomes equal to the sun's.
